On behalf of @BJP4TamilNadu, we extend our deepest condolences on the passing away of former Prime Minister Thiru Manmohan Singh avl. A leader with strong acumen in economics, his tenure as the Finance Minister of India steered the country towards a liberalised economy, paving the way for the start of India’s bold reforms. 

His profound actions spoke more than his words; key legislations such as the Right to Information Act, among others, stand as a testament to his commitment to the welfare of the people. His contribution to the development of India will continue to inspire others in service to the people. 

Let his soul find peace at the lotus feet of the Almighty. Om Shanthi.
